scope: Read-only frozen-state recovery diagnostic; only two independent linear global L2 projection solves, no nonlinear or time-path solve.

definitions.qD: consistent Q1 L2(g(v_h)*p_eff(u_h,c_h)), same2x2 quadrature as the UEL
definitions.qE: consistent Q1 L2(p_eff(u_h,c_h)), same frozen state and quadrature

limitations: Unconverged failed Newton state only; neither recovered gradient is an exact physical/reference gradient.
No path solve, mesh/time convergence study, replacement formulation, or evidence that pressure recovery caused the nonlinear failure.
q/g is a diagnostic quotient rather than a required constitutive unknown; normalized ratios exclude |p_eff|<.01 global p_rms.
Two projections use the existing2x2 quadrature and fixed Q1 mesh; finite-h recovery, interpolation, and quadrature effects are not separated.
